result.summary: The page is generally polished; the only notable visual defect is a restaurant name clipped by a card edge in the horizontal carousel (not the allowed last-item cutoff).

issues.description: In the Fastest near you row, the third restaurant name “Trattoria Piccol” is cut off at the right edge of its own card (not just the screen), so the name looks truncated.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a slightly smaller type size, or give each carousel card enough width so full restaurant names remain readable.
